n3006b5e9de.headline: Value of Kellner's PPF grew to 900 billion crowns
n3006b5e9de.summary: In the first half of the year, the PPF group increased its total assets to almost 35 billion euros, equivalent to nearly 900 billion Czech crowns, with net profit rising compared to the previous period.
n3006b5e9de.why: PPF is a major investment group in Central Europe, and its asset growth reflects broader economic trends and investment performance in the region.
